companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
CREALOGIX is a leading global FinTech software solutions provider working with some of the most innovative financial brands in the world. We are dynamic and growing with over 600 employees around the world including Switzerland, Germany, Spain, the UK, the Middle East and Singapore.

Some of the world’s largest banks and wealth management firms select and deploy our advanced SaaS and cloud-based technologies to meet their customers’ needs – and it’s our people who make the difference.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a Business Expert with a strong business and market-oriented mindset, who will act as a key link between client needs, market insights and internal solution design.

This role goes beyond traditional business analysis.

The objective is to ensure that our solutions are aligned with market demands and client expectations, while contributing to business growth initiatives.

Your mission

  • Act as a trusted advisor, translating business and client needs into solutions
  • Analyze the Middle East market, developing a deep understanding of industry trends within this target region.
  • Understand client challenges within banking and fintech sector and provide insights to position CREALOGIX solutions competitively
  • Ensure alignment across different teams and stakeholders, supporting effective collaboration and consistency in delivering solutions.
  • Model solutions and define user flows and processes
  • Gather and document business requirements (BRDs, workshops, stakeholders) translating them into clear, functional solutions aligned with business needs
  • Mantain quality and consistency in documentation and processes
  • Support RFPs, bids and proposals in collaboration with the sales team
  • Help build and maintain strong client relationships
  • Participate in client meetings, presentations, and client-facing discussions when required.
  • Work in Agile environments when required
  • Apply AI in a strategic and responsible way, ensuring data accuracy, ethical use, and alignment with company and client standards
  • Identify opportunities to enhance processes and solutions through AI while staying up to date with relevant advancements

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Requirements

+5 years of experience as:

  • Business Analyst / Functional Consultant / similar role
  • Experience gathering and documenting functional requirements (BRDs, workshops)
  • Strong communication skills with international stakeholders
  • Fluent in English (C1+)
  • Analytical mindset + ability to translate business into solutions
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (Product, Tech, Business)
  • Experience using AI tools in a professional environment to enhance analysis, decision-making, or efficiency, with a strong understanding of their strategic, ethical, and responsible use (including data, governance, and risk considerations)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience in financial services / fintech
  • Exposure to Middle East / KSA markets
  • Experience in bids / presales / RFP processes
  • Familiarity with UML or functional modelling
  • Experience in agile delivery environments

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
As a Senior QA Tester, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software products. Your responsibilities will be manual testing across both desktop and mobile platforms, leveraging your experience and understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and best practices. Your role will involve close collaboration with development and QA teams to ensure that all defects are identified, documented, and resolved before product release.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manual Testing: Execute detailed manual test cases on desktop and mobile applications to ensure software meets functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Defect Tracking and Resolution: Collaborate with the development team to report, track, and resolve defects efficiently, ensuring high-quality software delivery.
  • Test Case Development: Work closely with QA Analysts to design and develop comprehensive test cases that cover all aspects of the software, including edge cases and potential failure points.
  • Test Planning: Contribute to the creation and refinement of test plans and strategies, ensuring all features are thoroughly tested before release.
  • Quality Assurance: Maintain a high standard of quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle, identifying areas for improvement in both the testing process and the product itself.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Required Skills

  • Experience: Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in manual testing, focused on web and mobile application testing.
  • Software Development Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of both QA and software development lifecycles, with the ability to integrate testing processes seamlessly into the overall development process.
  • Communication: Proficient in reading and writing in English (at least a B2 level), with the ability to clearly document test cases, defects, and reports.
  • Tool Proficiency: Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Test Management tools, with a proven ability to manage and document testing activities.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, ensuring all potential issues are identified and addressed before product release.
  • Proactivity and Problem-Solving: A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to handle ad-hoc requests and meet multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaboration: A team player who works flexibly and collaboratively, with a focus on achieving the overall success of the team and the project.

Desired Skills

  • Test Automation Experience: Familiarity with automation testing tools like Selenium and Appium, with the ability to work closely with automation teams.
  • Programming Knowledge: Basic understanding of JavaScript, which will be beneficial when working with development teams or automation scripts.
  • Integrated Development Environment (IDE) Experience: Experience working with IDEs such as IntelliJ, Eclipse, or similar tools, allowing for a better understanding of the development environment and processes.
  • Functional Analysis: Experience in functional analysis and test case design, ensuring comprehensive coverage of all test scenarios.
  • Continuous Learning: A desire to stay updated with the latest trends in QA and software development, with a willingness to learn new tools and technologies.

Language

  • Fluent in Arabic
  • Fluent in English
